episodes.title: Leon Brown Speaks on Cult Upbringing | Raleigh News
episodes.description: Leon Brown, known from Sister Wives, reveals a shocking past: raised in a cult with four parents, homeschooled until age ten, then thrust into an intense religious indoctrination program in Utah. Despite the strict rules and fear of the outside world, Leon excelled — but the trauma shaped their identity and fractured their family. Their estrangement from father Kody deepened after Garrison's death, with Leon calling Kody a liar. This isn't isolated — Christine Brown, Leon's dad's ex-wife, also wrote about raising kids in a cult.
